summary: Configured split-horizon DNS: node1 (VyOS, lan-a router, PowerDNS Recursor) resolves app.internal to node3's lan-a address 10.10.1.10; node2 (OPNsense, lan-b router, Unbound) resolves app.internal to node4's lan-b address 10.10.2.10. Topology was discovered via STP bridge-id matching (node1 eth1<->node2 vtnet1=transit, node1 eth2<->node3 ens7=lan-a, node2 vtnet2<->node4 ens7=lan-b), statically addressed (dhcp:false segments), and DNS configured via VyOS static-host-mapping + dns forwarding, and OPNsense unboundplus host override + firewall pass rule. All 4 nodes were sequentially restarted per the mandatory protocol, boot identity change confirmed on each, and DNS/service health verified post-recovery.
actions_performed: Discovered node1(VyOS)/node2(OPNsense)/node3(Ubuntu16)/node4(Ubuntu16) topology and mapped extra NICs to lan-a/lan-b/transit networks via STP bridge-id correlation

Assigned static IPs: node1 eth1=10.10.0.1/30 (transit), eth2=10.10.1.254/24 (lan-a); node2 vtnet1=10.10.0.2/30 (transit), vtnet2=10.10.2.254/24 (lan-b); node3 ens7=10.10.1.10/24; node4 ens7=10.10.2.10/24
Configured VyOS node1: dns forwarding listen-address/allow-from on lan-a, static-host-mapping app.internal->10.10.1.10, committed and saved to config.boot
Persisted node3 ens7 static config + dns-nameservers in /etc/network/interfaces.d/ens7.cfg

Configured OPNsense node2 via config.xml surgery: added opt1(transit)/opt2(lanb) interfaces, firewall pass rule for opt2, unboundplus host override app.internal->10.10.2.10; applied via configctl interface reconfigure and configctl unbound start
Persisted node4 ens7 static config + dns-nameservers in /etc/network/interfaces.d/ens7.cfg
Verified DNS resolution end-to-end on node3 and node4 before restart protocol
Captured pre-restart boot identity (boot_id/boottime) baseline on all 4 nodes

Sequentially restarted node1, node2, node3, node4 one at a time, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot identity on each, and re-verified interface config, DNS service status, and app.internal resolution after each restart
